bar_color.description: Color of the ribbon track (the non-visible area).
bar_color.label: Background Color

gaps.description: The 'layout.gaps' value from your niri config, in logical pixels. Used for accurate canvas width and padding calculation.
gaps.label: Layout Gaps

radius.description: Corner radius of the viewport highlight (logical pixels).
radius.label: Corner Radius

thickness.description: Vertical thickness of the ribbon (logical pixels).
thickness.label: Thickness

viewport_color.description: Color of the highlighted viewport region.
viewport_color.label: Viewport Color

viewport_model.description: How the viewport position is estimated. Should match your niri 'center-focused-column' setting. 'Fit' (default) works with niri's default 'never'; 'Center' works with 'always'.
viewport_model.label: Viewport Model
